as someone who’s been working in an animal shelters for 6+ years, this brought so many tears to my eyes. the chaos of all the adopters is exactly what our adoption events are like; you feel lost, confused, happy, excited, but also sad for the ones being looked over. getting the “do you have any small dogs?” question EVERY DAY gets so exhausting while such good dogs are sitting there looking for their person. i’m so happy you guys did background checks and got happy updates because so many adoptions can fail, especially during chaotic times like events such as this. i hope everyone had continued support, especially training! beautiful video and loved seeing Dave get to be apart of it. i would love to see more pitbull and shelter advocation as the overpopulation crisis is as bad as ever! and please help educate people on backyard breeding and doodles
